## MGIT ECE Department Signs MoU with SANSI RF and Communication Systems Pvt. Ltd.

News Date : 09 Jun 2026News ReportThe Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) withSANSI RF and Communication Systems Pvt. Ltd., Secunderabad, on9 June 2026to foster academic excellence, research collaboration, and industry engagement.The MoU aims to establish a long-term partnership in the areas of academic research, industry-oriented training, skill development, internships, joint research and development (R&D) projects, technology transfer, and student entrepreneurship initiatives.Through this collaboration, students and faculty will gain opportunities to work closely with industry experts, participate in real-world projects, and strengthen their practical knowledge in emerging technologies. The partnership will focus on key domains such asRF and Communication Systems, Embedded Systems, Signal Processing, Internet of Things (IoT),and other advanced communication technologies.This initiative reflects MGIT’s continued commitment to bridging the gap between academia and industry by providing students with enhanced opportunities for professional upskilling, innovation, and experiential learning, while promoting collaborative research and technological advancement.

The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) withSANSI RF and Communication Systems Pvt. Ltd., Secunderabad, on9 June 2026to foster academic excellence, research collaboration, and industry engagement.
The MoU aims to establish a long-term partnership in the areas of academic research, industry-oriented training, skill development, internships, joint research and development (R&D) projects, technology transfer, and student entrepreneurship initiatives.
Through this collaboration, students and faculty will gain opportunities to work closely with industry experts, participate in real-world projects, and strengthen their practical knowledge in emerging technologies. The partnership will focus on key domains such asRF and Communication Systems, Embedded Systems, Signal Processing, Internet of Things (IoT),and other advanced communication technologies.
This initiative reflects MGIT’s continued commitment to bridging the gap between academia and industry by providing students with enhanced opportunities for professional upskilling, innovation, and experiential learning, while promoting collaborative research and technological advancement.
